# Copilot Instructions — debate-decision-system (modernization)

> Generated by doc-and-modernize. **Do not overwrite** `.github/copilot-instructions.md` (caveman). Merge by hand if you want one file.

This repo is **already on the target stack**. Work is residual hardening in `MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md`, not a rewrite. Package is **lit** (L3). UI e2e is **dropped** (L1 pixels). CI workflow exists; **enforcing** required checks is a human GitHub Settings step.

See `MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md` and `ARCHITECTURE.md`.

## Commands

| Action | Command |
|--------|---------|
| Install / restore deps | `uv sync --all-groups` |
| Frozen CI install | `uv sync --all-groups --frozen` |
| Build | `uv build` |
| Run / serve locally | `uv run streamlit run app.py` (port 8522). Agents: **do not launch**. |
| Unit tests (all) | `uv run pytest` / `make test` |
| Single test file | `uv run pytest tests/test_debate.py` |
| Single test by name | `uv run pytest tests/test_debate.py::test_initial_state_and_routing` |
| Lint | `uv run ruff check` |
| Format / check | `uv run ruff format .` / `uv run ruff format --check` |
| Typecheck | `uv run ty check src/` |
| Audit | `uv run pip-audit .` |
| Hooks | `prek run --all-files` |
| End-to-end / live LLM | **none** |
| Contract / characterization | Phase 1: `advance()` role golden in `tests/` |

CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) runs frozen sync → ruff → format → ty → pytest → pip-audit, plus prek, on `ubuntu-latest` for `push` to `main` and all PRs. Stood up already (Phase 0). **Enforcement is manual:** GitHub → Settings → Branches → required checks `quality` and `hooks`. Until then CI runs but does not block merges.

## Phase gating

A phase is not complete until its Verification & Exit Criteria in `MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md` pass, are recorded, and the PR is merged to **`main`**.

- **Lit (package):** `make lint` and `uv run pytest` must pass.
- **Dark:** none scheduled.
- Never require a UI e2e gate. That component never crosses an e2e Testability Milestone in this plan.

## Decisions

- Leave Streamlit / LangGraph / SQLite. Drop live LLM e2e. Drop containers/auth unless product says otherwise.
- Pin `advance()`, not `debate_graph.invoke`.
- Update `MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md` markers (✅ / ⏭️ / 🗑️) when a phase exits.

## Branching & PRs

Trunk is **`main`**. No `master`. One branch per phase (`phase-1-advance-golden`, `phase-2-coverage`), cut from `main`, merge to `main` before the next. `git log origin/main..HEAD` empty at cut. No stacked phase PRs.

Any topology or command change updates this file, `README.md`, and `ARCHITECTURE.md` in the **same PR**.
